text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian claimed victory in the Tokyo 
Yushun (Japanese Derby), splendidly 
securing the second crown of the Triple 
Crown.

Expectations are mounting, with whispers 
that she could even aim for the Triple 
Crown. Narita Brian, too, showed a fierce 
fighting spirit.

Meanwhile, Hishi Amazon had also claimed 
two crowns on the Tiara path. The two 
resolved to settle things at the Arima 
Kinen.

Narita Brian lets her fighting spirit boil 
over. First, to seize the Kikuka Sho, the 
final leg of the Classic Triple Crown—!
